headline: Recovery is on the menu

highlights: Domino’s India LFL improved to 4.1% (on a high base of 9.1%), Dine-In and Take-Away (DITA) returned to growth, and Popeyes sustained 53% LFL.
India gross margins expanded (110bps) and EBITDA margin held, despite unplanned cost inflation.
However, consolidated PAT was flat (standalone +8% YoY), weighed by higher depreciation and lease cost from India expansion and hyperinflation accounting at DP Eurasia.

Domino’s India LFL recovery gathers pace Domino's India revenue grew 9.2% YoY, with LFL growth improving for the third consecutive quarter to 4.1% (Q1FY27: 2.5%; Q4FY26: 0.2%), despite a high base of 9.1% in Q2FY26.
valuation: We see a stronger H2, with a soft base and festive demand supporting LFL acceleration towards target of 5–7%.
Management maintained its FY27 LFL growth target of 5–7% and indicated Q3 is tracking in line with its plan.
Valuation and risk We cut our earnings estimates for FY27/FY28 by 9.1%/9.6%.
watch: Late night emerged as a key growth driver, with 90%+ of the network now serviceable until 3am.
H2 LFL of 2.4% vs. 10.4% for H1) and includes two key festive periods (Diwali and Christmas–New Year).
